name: design
description: How should it look and feel? A design-system spine with the design-critic agent: house rules (design-doctrine), DTCG design tokens in three tiers, brand kits, a token build, governance, migration to or from external design systems, Figma sync and DESIGN.md; component, screen and dashboard design with any-framework code generation, image-to-code, redesign and fidelity prototypes; UX writing. Directions against generated-looking UI: frontend-design, impeccable, hallmark, ui-ux-pro-max, Emil Kowalski's design engineering and 138 named design systems. Gates that measure instead of claim: contrast, states, axe, keyboard, target size, overflow, reduced motion and responsive behaviour in light and dark; WCAG 2.2 audits, screen-reader testing and Core Web Vitals. Critique with a Rams lens, design review and plan-design-review. Adapted from plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills (MIT) and vendored skills; see NOTICE.md.
